# Mentingo

> Mentingo is an open-source, self-hosted learning management system (LMS) with a built-in AI mentor, built for enterprise learning and development: employee onboarding, sales and product enablement, and mandatory compliance training. It is MIT-licensed, white-label and multi-tenant. Built and maintained by Selleo.

Key facts:

- Licence: MIT (permissive - white-label and resell allowed, no copyleft obligation)
- Hosting: self-hosted on your own infrastructure, one-click CloudFormation deployment from AWS Marketplace (free listing, pay only for AWS resources), or managed by Selleo
- Stack: TypeScript, NestJS, Remix (Vite SPA), Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector, Redis, S3-compatible storage
- AI: Vercel AI SDK with your own provider key, LangChain, pgvector retrieval, LiveKit real-time voice, Langfuse tracing
- Authentication: Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Slack OAuth 2.0 SSO, TOTP two-factor
- Multi-tenancy: enforced in PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security
- Interoperability: SCORM 1.2 export, OpenAPI/Swagger, CSV and XLSX import/export
- UI languages: English, Polish, German, Spanish, French, Czech
